title: Upstream doc monitor result
description: Machine-readable result.json consumed by the frontend, uploaded as an artifact by the upstream-doc-monitor job. A bare array; each item reports one monitored doc entry.

project.description: Project name of the monitored entry.

doc.description: Full URL of the monitored document, matching the configured url field: a GitHub blob URL for repo_file entries, the web page URL for web_page entries.

version.description: Upstream version tag; null when the entry carries no version marker or is a web page.

status.description: Current state: error = detection failed, pending = changed and awaiting confirmation (an open ticket exists), unchanged = no change detected.

ticket.description: HTML URL of the open ticket; null when there is none.
